scenarios.scenario_abstract: [X] abandons a hot, humid Tokyo window in favor of a walking-heavy week in late autumn, using cooler air and crisp evenings to explore local neighborhoods rather than planning around heat recovery.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: [X]会放弃炎热潮湿的东京时段，把大量步行的一周改到深秋，利用凉爽空气和清冽夜晚探索本地街区，而不用围绕中暑后的恢复来安排行程。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Before moving to Oulu for university, [X] prepares everyday study, commuting, sleep, and social routines for months of deep cold and darkness, brief muddy transitions, and summer nights that remain bright.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 搬到奥卢上大学前，[X]会为数月严寒与黑暗、短暂泥泞过渡期以及持续明亮的夏夜，提前调整日常学习、通勤、睡眠和社交节奏。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While gardening at home, [X] times fast-growing cherry-tomato seedlings by the local last frost, stable night temperatures, and soil warmth so transplanting and harvest fit the usable growing season.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在家中种植时，[X]会根据本地末次霜冻、稳定夜温和土壤温度安排速生樱桃番茄移栽，使定植和收获都落在可利用的生长季内。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a two-week Scotland route built around castles, history, and major cities, [X] chooses a quieter shoulder season by balancing rain risk, long sightseeing days, open sites, crowd levels, and train access.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为以城堡、历史和主要城市为主的两周苏格兰路线选择时间时，[X]会权衡降雨风险、较长观光日、景点开放、拥挤程度和铁路可达性，最终采用较安静的平季。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Because strong sun affects [X]'s body, [X] deliberately chooses Cape Town in rainy June and reshapes five days around indoor culture, scenic drives, comfortable food stops, and short clear-weather openings.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 由于强烈日晒会影响身体，[X]主动选择多雨的六月前往开普敦，并把五天行程改成室内文化、景观驾车、舒适餐饮停留和短暂晴天窗口。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While choosing a birthday surprise in winter, [X] rejects a dress that would remain unused until spring or summer and adds a warm scarf that can be worn immediately while still coordinating with the intended gift.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 冬季挑选生日惊喜时，[X]会放弃必须等到春夏才能穿的连衣裙，改为加入可以立即使用、又能呼应原礼物构想的保暖围巾。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: When city cold removes the outdoor routines [X] normally enjoys, [X] preserves exercise through home strength work, indoor facilities, and brief properly layered walks instead of suspending activity until spring.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 城市寒冷天气中，原本喜欢的户外活动难以继续时，[X]会通过居家力量训练、室内场馆和短时保暖步行维持运动，而不是一直停练到春天。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Before winter closes the outdoor season, [X] and a partner combine an early-sunset picnic with a drive-in movie and adapt warm food, blankets, lighting, allergy-safe snacks, and wine to an evening that becomes colder after dark.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在冬季结束户外活动季之前，[X]和伴侣会把早落日野餐与汽车影院结合起来，为入夜后持续降温的晚间调整热食、毯子、照明、低过敏零食和葡萄酒。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: To reduce air-conditioning use in summer, [X] rejects a salvaged cooler design that merely shifts electricity use to ice making and rebuilds it around evaporation, cross-ventilation, and the local humidity limit.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为了在夏季减少空调用电，[X]会否定把耗电转移到制冰环节的旧件降温方案，改为围绕蒸发、对流通风和本地湿度上限重新设计。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For four winter days near Tromso primarily to see the aurora, [X] fits flights, one guided chase, local transport, and lodging within a fixed ceiling while preserving multiple dark-sky attempts and severe-cold preparation.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 冬季在特罗姆瑟附近停留四天、主要为了看极光时，[X]会在固定预算内安排航班、一次向导追光、本地交通和住宿，同时保留多次黑暗天空尝试与严寒准备。
